philippines.title: BuCor to help inmates form co-ops for livelihood after release
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Corrections (BuCor) will help persons deprived of liberty (PDLs) establish cooperatives that could provide them with jobs and sustainable livelihoods after their release, as part of efforts to improve their reintegration into society. BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio Catapang Jr. directed superintendents of operating prisons and penal farms to assist inmates in organizing and managing the cooperatives, which will operate like small and medium enterprises, the bureau said in a statement on Tuesday. Under the initiative, former inmates are expected to manage their own businesses, including bookkeeping and other administrative operations, allowing them to turn the […]...

philippines.title: BuCor flags low number of applicants for vacant prison officer posts
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Corrections (BuCor) is struggling to attract applicants for hundreds of vacant supervisory and senior officer positions, prompting its chief to urge uniformed personnel to undergo mandatory career and leadership training to qualify for promotion. BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio Catapang Jr. said the bureau needed more qualified personnel to fill its vacancies, particularly in higher-ranking positions. “We need qualified personnel to be promoted so that we can fill up the vacant positions,” Catapang said in a statement dated Nov. 22. Of the 42 vacant positions for Corrections Chief Inspector, only six personnel have applied. The bureau […]...
